category: backup storage / SFTP box (RAID-6, Enterprise HDD)

free_tier.stated: 250 GB $3/mo · 500 GB $4/mo · 1 TB $6/mo · 2 TB $11/mo. Germany (Falkenstein) and Finland (Helsinki) sold as separate product groups.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: No retention statement documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
retention.notes: No retention clause documented in available terms.

egress.terms: "Unmetered Traffic" with "1 GBit/s" port, on both the DE and FI product pages. This is the cleanest egress term among the records read. A port speed with no counter and no published fair-use threshold.

tooling: rsync/Borg/restic over SSH. No S3, no WebDAV.
chaining: Archive/backup leg only. No object API means it cannot serve the hot set or back a Cloudflare origin directly.
limits_note: WebDAV and S3 protocols are not supported. Storage plans cap at 2 TB per server instance.
reliability_note: Hosting provider advertises 256 GB RAM Xeon E5-1650v3 storage nodes with RAID-6 arrays and unmetered 1 Gbit/s network links. Promotional discounts are reported on hosting forums but unverified at checkout without placing an order.
